definitions.explanation: An unspecified small number of occasions, typically two to five or so. The prefix {数|すう} (several) attaches to the counter {回|かい} (times, occurrences).

examples.japanese: {年|ねん}に{数回|すうかい}{会|あ}う。
examples.english: We meet several times a year.

examples.japanese: この{薬|くすり}は{一日|いちにち}{数回|すうかい}{飲|の}む。
examples.english: Take this medicine several times a day.

examples.japanese: {去年|きょねん}は{海外|かいがい}に{数回|すうかい}{出張|しゅっちょう}した。
examples.english: Last year I went on several business trips abroad.

notes:
The prefix {数|すう} attaches to counters to mean "several" of that unit. Vaguer than a specific number, but implies a modest count rather than many.

RELATED COUNTS:
- {数日|すうじつ}: several days
- {数人|すうにん}: several people
- {数年|すうねん}: several years
- {数時間|すうじかん}: several hours
